newsitem.title: UK: Weather disrupts loading at Russia's Novorossiisk.
newsitem.headline: Weather disrupts loading at Russia's Novorossiisk.

text.p: High winds and swell were disrupting crude and oil product loadings at Russia's Black Sea port of Novorossiisk on Thursday but vessels were still berthing, shipping sources said.
The bad weather was adding to delays caused by the suspension of crude supplies on Tuesday to allow planned pipeline repairs to be carried out, traders said.

Shipping sources said the port was declared closed at 1540 local time on Wednesday and remained shut on Thursday morning, although the Matilda was docking at berth one to load one million barrels of crude.
A dispatcher at the state-run Black Sea Oil Pipeline System said crude supplies to the port were halted at 0600 GMT on Tuesday for up to 80 hours.
